title: Trump's EEOC strikes harassment guidance amid debate over transgender protections
summary: The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission voted 2-1 to roll back the agency's 2024 harassment guidance in its entirety. The document gave employers information on what makes up unlawful harassment.
contentText:
The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission voted 2-1 to roll back the agency's 2024 harassment guidance in its entirety. The document gave employers information on what makes up unlawful harassment.

(Image credit: Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images)
